scope: Clan durable bank transfers, atomic snapshots, shared chat preference, member concurrency, owner delivery and lifecycle integration

main_verify.reason: StarSupply production and test sources unchanged

compilation.mode: incremental on previously complete Core production compilation

coverage: Real player money and Clan file persistence across both restarts
Lost receipts, intent/final replacement faults, conflicting receipts, corruption and rejected transfers
Caller cancellation cannot discard admitted transfers; unresolved bank blocks disband
Migration marker and new Clan identity persist before any player money call
Atomic snapshot failures, concurrent mutation generation, missing/corrupt roots and legacy reload
Concurrent tag creation and capacity, expired invitations, outsider permissions and leader ranks
Actual CompatScheduler owner assertions for chat, teleport, bank messages and stopped callbacks
Private messages do not become public when Clan service is missing
Public lifecycle startup and shutdown; plugin registration/API/feedback/HUD regression
Extreme exponent and fractional money input rejected before scale expansion
Selected economy provider must expose durable receipts; no hidden fallback to a different wallet
All StarSupply tests against the exact final Core artifact, including 11 real player-money and nine tax scenarios
limitations: Bukkit actors and native scheduling APIs are controlled test doubles, without a running server
Clan metadata has periodic snapshots; non-financial recent edits can be lost on abrupt process death
Bank history uses full file snapshots; no large-history performance benchmark or pruning protocol
Shutdown waits at most five seconds, preserving unresolved durable intents for restart
Legacy bank balances are imported without certifying historical source or automatically paying old withdrawals
pending: Religion and other Core modules outside logistics profile still need Folia adaptation
Current complete optional-plugin combination and production support declaration
Current Clan/HUD/financial integration on Paper/Folia and graphical client effects
Six-resource survival production, delivery, sustained consumption and restart acceptance
MySQL integration, historical-receipt scale and bounded storage/retention design
